facts.text: Uncle Dave built this park for families, so the snack stand had better be good. I'll take the biggest hot dog.
facts.why: Invented line signed Axel Foley. The film's Axel never says it. His real lines at the park include 'Yeah I'm ok, just don't let go' while hanging off the Spider ride.
facts.fix: Yeah, I'm okay, just don't let go.

fix_note.text: Yeah, I'm okay, just don't let go.

facts.text: Rosewood's order, back on duty at Wonder World.
facts.why: Rosewood is back on duty at WonderWorld, joining Axel and Flint in the final shootout. 'Order' is the usual menu joke.

facts.text: Rosewood back in action with a shotgun
facts.why: No shotgun shows in the plot. Rosewood and Flint come to WonderWorld when Axel calls them and the shootout leaves all three hurt.
facts.fix: Rosewood back in action at Wonder World

vibe.verdict: A good theme park snack stand with the Spider line, the line jumper pass and Todd's last words, though the food notes are mostly plain.
